title: Hyderabad - GHMC plan sanction (seed)
citation: Telangana Building Rules 2012, administered by GHMC
verify: Telangana submissions run through the TS-bPASS single-window system, and the instant-approval route for small residential plots asks for a different, shorter set than a full scrutiny. Confirm the route, and confirm the current TS-bPASS upload requirements, before submitting. Every field below is a seed.

sheets.note: Site plan with the plot dimensioned against the abutting road.
One plan per storey, including any cellar.
Built-up area, setbacks and height against the plot-size band.
